fusions.name: Driving the Herd
fusions.desc: Drives through a cone 3 tiles ahead for 12 damage, pushing every enemy hit 3 tiles back and leaving it [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Heeler's Nip
fusions.desc: Nips the target for 4 damage, leaving it 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds, with a 25% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Stock on the Move
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds, and fights with 1 more power while it holds.

fusions.name: Stockyard Partner
fusions.desc: A bonded heeler follows you and nips enemies within 4 tiles for 3 damage every 1.6 seconds. Each kill restores 3 health, and your abilities come round 5% sooner.
